title: THURSDAY LIGHT SEATED INTERVALS
subtitle: SHORT, EASY BURSTS IN THE CHAIR WITH KIND HIPS, THEN A LITTLE STANDING AT THE CHAIR. NO FLOOR TODAY.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Thursday is our light seated intervals, about eleven minutes. Short easy bursts in the chair: a gentle march, a row, a light press, and a soft figure four. Then we stand for a few sit to stands, a kind hip flexor stretch, and a little balance at the chair. No floor today. A smaller range is fine on sore-joint days. Lovely to see you.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, shoulders soft, and take one slow easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Settle in. No rush at all.
script.lastSet: Last one of these. Keep it comfortable.
script.complete: That's us, Pam. A few cheerful little bursts, hips looked after, and you showed up again. Another small win in the book. Have a sip of water and enjoy your Thursday. Well done.
script.pause: Paused. Take all the time you need.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED MARCH (EASY INTERVALS)
exercises.cue: Sit tall, hands lightly on the sides of the chair. March gently for about twenty seconds, lifting each foot just an inch or two off the floor. Swing the arms softly if you like. Keep the lifts low so nothing pinches at the front of the hip, especially the left. Pick a pace that feels cheerful, not puffed out. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated march intervals. Three easy bursts of twenty seconds. Lift the feet just a little and march at a happy pace. Keep it low on the left side.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet down. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair. With a light band looped round something sturdy, or just with empty hands, reach forward then draw the elbows back close to your sides and gently squeeze the shoulder blades together. Slow and smooth for about twenty seconds. Shoulders stay down, away from the ears. Empty hands are perfectly fine.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two bursts of twenty seconds. Reach forward, draw the elbows back, and gently squeeze the shoulder blades. Band or empty hands, both are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Drop the shoulders and breathe.
exercises.speakDone: Rows done. Lovely tall posture, Pam.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Sit tall with feet flat. Hold light hand weights, or nothing at all, at shoulder height. Press up slowly, only as high as is comfortable, then lower with control. Keep a steady easy rhythm for about twenty seconds. On sore-joint days, press only halfway or use empty hands. Never push through shoulder pain.
exercises.speakStart: Light overhead press. Two bursts of twenty seconds. Press up slowly, only as high as feels comfy, and lower with control. Empty hands are perfectly fine.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Arms down. Shake them out.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE-FOUR (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat. Rest the right ankle over the left thigh, just above the knee. Stay tall and tip forward from the hips only a touch, until you feel a mild stretch in the outer hip. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch sides. Never press the knee down or fold deep. If the left groin or front of the hip pinches, skip that side or simply rest the ankle without leaning. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated figure four, nice and light. About twenty seconds each side. Rest one ankle over the other thigh, sit tall, and tip forward just a touch. Skip the left side if it pinches.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Figure four done. That's the chair work finished. Stay seated, we'll stand up next.

exercises.name: SIT-TO-STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of the chair, feet hip-width and flat, a little behind the knees. Lean forward slightly and press through the heels to stand tall. Sit back down slowly with control. Use your hands on your thighs or the chair arms as much as you like. On sore-joint days, do fewer or just practise the lean forward. Finish standing.
exercises.speakStart: Sit to stands. Five slow ones. Lean forward a touch, press through the heels, and stand tall. Lower back down slowly. Hands can help. Finish standing up.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay standing, hand on the chair back.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stands done. Good strong legs, Pam.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP FLEXOR
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair with one hand lightly on the chair back. Step one foot back about half a step, not a deep lunge, both feet pointing forward, knees soft. Gently tuck the pelvis under until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the back hip. A tiny lean is enough. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds, then swap. Start with the left leg back and keep that side extra gentle. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Standing hip flexor. About twenty seconds each leg. Hand on the chair, small step back, tuck the pelvis, tiny lean. Left leg first, extra gentle.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet together. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Hip flexor stretch done. Front of the hips looked after.

exercises.name: CHAIR-SUPPORTED BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand tall behind the chair with both hands resting lightly on the back. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other heel, or the whole foot, just off the floor. Keep the standing knee soft, shoulders back and down, eyes ahead. Hold about fifteen seconds, then switch. Grip the chair as much as you need; toes touching down is perfectly fine. Keep the lifted leg low and relaxed so nothing pinches at the front of the hip.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. About fifteen seconds each leg, twice through. Hands on the chair, stand tall, and lift one foot just off the floor. Toes can touch down any time.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, Pam. Happy little bursts and kind hips. Have a lovely Thursday.
